content: VT323 by Peter Hull: SIL OFL licensed, on Google Fonts, replicates DEC VT320 CRT terminal glyphs including horizontal phosphor smear, monospaced and legible at body-text sizes. Press Start 2P by CodeMan38: also OFL and Google Fonts, blockier 8-bit arcade look, best for accents or headers not body text. Departure Mono: free purpose-built terminal monospace, not on Google Fonts, self-hosted download, more restrained CRT look than VT323, license not independently re-verified in this pass.
